fix: preserve duplicate user properties with empty-string value (#161)

The MQTT 5 parser aggregated repeated User Properties sharing a name using
a truthiness check on the previously stored value. An empty string is a
valid zero-length UTF-8 string but is falsy, so a following occurrence of
the same name overwrote it via the else branch instead of appending,
silently dropping the empty value and collapsing the array to a scalar.

Use an explicit `!== undefined` presence check so every value is retained,
per MQTT 5.0 3.3.2.3.7 (a name may appear more than once) and 1.5.4
(UTF-8 strings may be zero
